5. Prior to joining China Status, my work experience can be summarised as follows:

(a) From January 1998 to September 2005, I worked as an Assistant Engineer at New Zealand Fire Services Engineering Co. Ltd.  
(b) From September 2005 to September 2006, I worked as a Project Engineer at Winning Engineering & Consultants Co. O/B Yearman Industrial Ltd.  
(c) From October 2006 to August 2014, I worked as a Project Engineer at Marvel Fire Engineering Co. Ltd.

(B) Background of China Status Development and Engineering Company Limited (中華發展工程有限公司)

6. I joined China Status in or around September 2014.

7. China Status is a Registered Fire Service Installation Contractor (註冊消防裝置承辦商) (“RFSIC”) (See “List of Registered Fire Service Installation Contractors” (as at 11 December 2025) available on FSD’s website at Annexure-1):

(a) Class 1, registration number: RC1/0466; and  
(b) Class 2, registration number: RC2/0637.

8. The requirements for registration include (see “Notes to Applicants for Registration as Fire Service Installation (FSI) Contractors in Classes 1 and/or 2” (both Chinese and English versions) at Annexure-2):

(a) Class 1:  
- The applicant or one of its directors, employees or partners must hold a degree in electrical engineering satisfying the examination requirements (Parts I and II) of the Council of Engineering Institutions for corporate membership of the Institution of Electrical Engineers.
